description.text: One of the two BW6 expansions released together on 13 July 2012. Black Kyurem, one of the cover Pokémon of Pokémon Black 2 and White 2, released that June, and a star of the summer film Kyurem vs. the Sword of Justice, appears as a Dragon-type Pokémon-EX; its attack Freeze Bolt leaves it unable to attack the next turn. Cresselia-EX and Landorus-EX join it. The two packs also brought Keldeo and Meloetta from the film and its short, and the first ACE SPEC Trainers. The cards are numbered to 59. In English it became part of Boundaries Crossed in November 2012, together with Cold Flare.
